name: Emma Frost

abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Reverse Controls: Rakibin yön tuşlarını tersine çevirerek hareketlerini karıştırır.

howToPlay: Emma Frost için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
White Queen
When Telepath Form is active and Emma would lose more than [50 - 5]% of her Base Health from a single source, she activates Diamond Form for 3 seconds to reduce the damage. Against Tech Champions, this ability triggers based on Max Health instead. This ability always activates before checking Armor and Resistances but does not activate on a Well-Timed Block.
When Emma uses a Special Attack, the Opponent's controls are reversed until just after the end of the attack. This will not trigger when fighting an Opponent with #Psychic Shielding.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Emma starts the fight in Diamond Form.
When Emma is at least one Power Level ahead of the Opponent, she deactivates Diamond Form and switches to Telepath Form.
When the Opponent is at least one Power Level ahead of Emma, she deactivates Telepath Form and switches to Diamond Form.
If the opponent uses an Armor Break while Emma is in Diamond Form, she is forced into Telepath Form, and cannot swap back for the duration of the Armor Break.

abilitySections.title: Passive - Diamond Form
content: Emma's organic diamond is immune to all Stun, Bleed, Poison, Incinerate, Shock, Frostbite, Coldsnap, Fatigue, Concussion, and Exhaustion effects.
Well-timed Blocks grant a Prowess Passive. Triggering an immunity to Bleed, Incinerate, or Shock grants 2 Prowess Passives.

When Emma changes into Diamond form, she replaces all temporary Prowess Passives with new indefinite Prowess Passives that increase Special Attack Damage by +10%. Prowess Passives are capped at 10 in Diamond Form.
10% chance that a Block is a Perfect Block, reducing all damage to 0.
+[485.29] Block Proficiency
+[2,250] Physical Resistance.
+[2,750] Critical Resistance Rating
Opponents have -[250] Critical Damage Rating

abilitySections.title: Passive - Telepath Form
content: When Emma changes into Telepath form, she replaces all indefinite Prowess Passives with new Prowess Passive that increase Special Attack Damage by +10% and last 12 seconds. Prowess Passives are capped at 15 in Telepath form.
Critical hits grant a Prowess Passive, and refresh all existing Prowess Passives.
Emma is able to read her Opponent's thoughts, allowing all of Emma's attacks to ignore Evade.
+[485.29] Critical Rate for each active Prowess effect.
+[56.12] Critical Damage Rating for each active Prowess effect.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack - Diamond Form
content: Generate 50% additional Power.
Opponents generate 80% less power from this attack.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack - Telepath Form
content: 100% chance to inflict a Taunt Debuff on the Opponent for 5 seconds.
These Debuffs are removed if Emma switches to Diamond Form.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Emma switches to Telepath form for the duration of the attack.
Once Emma finishes a Special Attack, all Prowess Passives are removed.
These attacks are Psychic and deal True Damage, ignoring all of the Opponent's Armor.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict Power Sting for 8 second(s). An Opponent with Power Sting takes [9,503.1] Direct Damage when activating a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict Concussion for 8 second(s), reducing the Opponent's Ability Accuracy by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to reduce the Opponent's Power Gain from all sources by 75% for 8 seconds.

Against Tech Champions, this ability triggers based on Max Health instead. This ability always activates before checking Armor and Resistances but does not activate on a Well-Timed Block.
When Emma uses a Special Attack, the Opponent's controls are reversed until just after the end of the attack. This will not trigger when fighting an Opponent with #Psychic Shielding.
